ReviewNotes: Reviewed all three exact source diffs, the full new sparse provider, the list wrapper, the unchanged renamed enumerator and the unique-Gram basis construction.

The constructor/contact changes admit one further external spin class only. Cubic matching, lower-amplitude contact calibration, graph/fermion-flow coverage, preparation, mandatory multi-parameter checks and rejection fallback are unchanged.

No independent Feynman scalar amplitude is used to construct source-current candidates. The common colour coordinate basis may include benchmark tensor directions, as before, to expose missing directions; this does not borrow its kinematic coefficients.

For every admitted primitive monomial, each internal colour index occurs twice on distinct factors and each external index once. Axis permutation, reshape and exact sparse Dot reorder finite sums and products only. Unsupported incidence, trace-power and dimension cases retain the original enumerator. No floating coefficients are admitted.
The generator axis order and complex phases match the retained component definitions. The final external axes use the original order; the Gram is Conjugate[V].Transpose[V].

Literal SameQ sharing preserves first occurrences. With real incidence S, T=S.U, the Gram is S.GU.Transpose[S], and original coordinates are the selected unique-coordinate rows. The exact unique Gram reconstruction and every occurrence are checked. Scalar spinor contributions remain separate and are all summed.

The private original-Gram flag defaults to True and the original state budget remains 65536. Only colour projection requests compact diagnostics, with an explicit NotMaterialized marker and the exact unique Gram/occurrence map. DefaultValues and Messages are literally unchanged.

The 65 exact controls, all 32768 components of a fresh five-gluon legacy vector, the 45-tensor/rank-six metric and all 3960 original occurrences were reviewed. The production tier additionally passed 360 checks across 11 suites, including independent compiled CH/MG controls. These controls support the finite-sum proof; they are not a replacement for it or a full five-gluon construction.

Existing checker definitions means the comparison, kinematic and model/runtime code remains exact. Its three specifically reviewed colour dependencies change implementation with the algebraic equivalence above; no end-to-end byte-identity claim is made for those dependencies.

New helper definitions have no load-time file/model/network/physics operations or persistent existing-symbol mutation. Scoped ordinary caches and temporary locals are not claimed constant during calculations. The sole changed cold OwnValue is the mechanically recomputed thirteen-file loader signature, verified on both sides.

Only the fixed 325 archived records may retain historical admission, with original contexts, seeds, options, timings and source capsules. No current constructor success, rerun or new validation is inferred. Failed, aborted, unsupported-context, supplemental-counterexample and precision-evidence guards remain mandatory.
